scripts.build: bun run build:lib && bun run --cwd apps/playground build
scripts.dev: bun run build:lib && bun run --cwd apps/playground dev
scripts.dev:https: bun run build:lib && bun run --cwd apps/playground dev:https
scripts.typecheck: bun run build:lib && bun run --cwd packages/nut-fountain typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/playground typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/nut-fountain test && bun run --cwd apps/playground test
scripts.test:browser: bun run --cwd packages/nut-fountain test:browser && bun run test:app
scripts.test:app: bun run build && bun run --cwd apps/playground test:browser
